description: This file defines a fake client implementation for testing Kubernetes client interactions, including support for listing, creating, updating, deleting, patching, and applying resources, with support for list and apply features.

classes.name: FakeClient
classes.description: A generic fake client for Kubernetes resources supporting CRUD operations and patching.

classes.name: FakeClientWithList
classes.description: A fake client extending FakeClient with support for listing resources.

classes.name: FakeClientWithApply
classes.description: A fake client extending FakeClient with support for applying declarative configurations.

classes.name: FakeClientWithListAndApply
classes.description: A fake client supporting both listing and applying configurations.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists resources matching label and field selectors.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Watches resources based on list options.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to a resource.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to a resource.

methods.name: ApplyStatus
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to a resource's status.

methods.name: Namespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the client.

methods.name: Kind
methods.description: Returns the GroupVersionKind of the resource.

methods.name: Resource
methods.description: Returns the GroupVersionResource of the resource.
